sloka: तथा सम्भाषमाणा सा सीता गन्गाम् अनिन्दिता ।दक्षिणा दक्षिणम् तीरम् क्षिप्रम् एव अभ्युपागमत् ॥२-५२-९२॥
transliteration: tathā sambhāṣamāṇā sā sītā gangām aninditā ।dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇam tīram kṣipram eva abhyupāgamat ॥2-52-92॥

translations.english: While the unblemished, auspicious Sita was thus addressing (the river), the boat swiftly reached the south bank.
